You become the main character,\nexploring the world of POKéMON.\lBy talking to people and solving\lmysteries, new paths will open to you.\lStrive for the goal together with your\lwonderful POKéMON.$

When you come across another person,\ngo up to them and press the A Button.\lThat will get them to talk and interact\lwith your character. You may also\lexamine various items and objects in\lthe same way. Talk to people and check\lthings often to obtain information.$
On the stairs or the exits of a\nbuilding is a red mat. Move your\lcharacter to stand on top of the\lred mat. Press the {PLUS} Control Pad \ltoward the stairs or the exit to\ladvance.$
This isn't something you should worry\nabout too much.\lTalk to other people, check signs,\lcheck things, and so on.\lSometimes, you may need to just move\lto a new town or place.$
Try moving on to a new road, town, or\nplace.$

There could be something in the town\nor inside a building that is the cause.\lTry talking to the people in the area\lagain. If there is a problem that they\lneed solved, you may have to help.\lAfterwards, try talking to the person\lblocking your way again.$

Try talking to people by going up to\nthem and pressing the A Button.\lAlso, try checking things like odd trees\land strange rocks with the A Button.\lPress the {PLUS} Control Pad and try going\lto places that look impassable, too.$
Try going to places where you \nhaven't visited yet.\lAlso, check everything that looks\lsuspicious by pressing the A Button.$

Any item that you are given by another\ncharacter goes in your BAG.\lThe item is automatically sorted and\lplaced in one of three pockets.\lFor instructions on the BAG's use,\lplease refer to the HELP System's\l“How do I do this?” heading.$

If POKéMON are hurt in battle,\ntake them to a POKéMON CENTER and\lhave them healed by the staff.\lGet in the habit of saving your\lgame and recording your progress.\lStock up on healing items at\lPOKéMON MARTS before traveling far.$
Forests are basically the same as\nroads but they can be like mazes.\lAll forests have a way out, so don't\lgive up if you get lost.$

Caves are dark and dangerous. Wild\nPOKéMON can appear anywhere in them.\lIf there is an emergency, rush to a\lPOKéMON CENTER or use items.\lNew towns await discovery beyond some\lcaves, so don't give up.$

The object of the game is to train\nyour POKéMON and move forward.\lYou must collect info and solve\lproblems. For example, what do you\lneed to get around an obstacle?\lWhat would get that impeding\lperson out of the way?$

There are several kinds of items.\nSome can be used only on the field.\lSome are only for use during battle.\lSome can be used anytime.\lTry using an item - if it can't be used,\lyou will be alerted.$

In a battle, POKéMON try to reduce\none another's vitality, expressed as\lHP. If a POKéMON's HP falls to zero,\lit faints, and the other POKéMON\lwins. By winning a battle, POKéMON\learn EXP. Points, which help them\llevel up (grow stronger).$
First, fully heal the POKéMON in your\nparty (the POKéMON with you) at any\lPOKéMON CENTER.\lYou should also buy healing items for\lemergencies at a POKéMON MART.$

A POKéMON's vitality is expressed in HP.\nIf a POKéMON is hurt in battle, HP is\lsubtracted. If its HP drops to zero,\lthe POKéMON faints.\lHeal hurt or fainted POKéMON at a\lPOKéMON CENTER or by using items.$

A POKéMON CENTER is like an inn for\nPOKéMON. It will fully heal POKéMON of\lany status problems and fully restore\ltheir HP using a special machine.\lThis service is free, so get in the\lhabit of healing your POKéMON often.$

A status problem refers to an ailment\nthat is inflicted on a POKéMON by its\lfoe's attack. These include burns,\lparalysis, poisoning, sleep, and\lfreezing. These can be healed by\lvisiting a POKéMON CENTER or using\lthe appropriate item.$

If all the POKéMON in your party\n(all the POKéMON with you) faint, you\llose some MONEY, and you are\lreturned home or to a POKéMON\lCENTER. To reduce that chance, visit\lPOKéMON CENTERS often. Also, get\lin the habit of saving often.$

If a wild POKéMON escapes from a POKé\nBALL, it's obviously still feisty.\lTry reducing its HP some more, and\ltry to weaken it with paralysis or sleep\lbefore trying to catch it.\lIf the POKé BALL rocks for a while,\lthe quarry is close to being caught!$

There are shops, known as POKéMON\nMARTS, that sell items.\lYou will not find POKéMON MARTS on\lroads, in forests, or in caves.\lStock up on needed items while you are\lvisiting a town with a POKéMON MART.$

You may buy POKé BALLS at any\nPOKéMON MART in any town.\lYou will not find POKéMON MARTS on\lroads, in forests, or in caves.\lStock up on POKé BALLS while you are\lvisiting a town with a POKéMON MART.$

A TRAINER is a person who raises\nPOKéMON through battling.\lTRAINERS will challenge you \lwherever they are - it could be on\la road, in forests, caves, anywhere.\lIf your eyes meet, you have to accept\ltheir challenge. So be careful!$

To beat a TRAINER in battle, use\nPOKéMON that have type advantages\lover the foe's POKéMON. You may also\luse highly trained POKéMON with\loverwhelming power. Outnumbering the\lfoe's POKéMON is another obvious\ltactic.$
Wild POKéMON will appear in tall grass,\non roads, and in forests. They will\lappear anywhere in dark caves.\lThere are no wild POKéMON or TRAINERS\lin towns, so they are safe places.$

POKéMON may learn up to four different\ntechniques, or moves. There is a great\lvariety of moves including attacks and\lthose with special effects. The kinds\lof moves that can be learned vary\lfor each POKéMON. Some moves\lcan be learned from machines.$

HIDDEN moves are those that are\nespecially important for your\ladventure. To use such a move outside\lof battle, open the “POKéMON” MENU\land make the POKéMON that knows the\lmove use it. A fainted POKéMON may use\la HIDDEN move outside of battle.$

Select “FIGHT,” and the MENU of moves\nwill appear. Consider the type\lmatchups, and use the most effective\lmoves. You can check the effects of\lmoves by opening “POKéMON,”\lpicking a POKéMON, opening “SUMMARY,”\lthen opening “POKéMON SKILLS.”$

The most a POKéMON can learn is four\nmoves. They are learned as the\lPOKéMON levels up. It can also be\ltaught a move using a TM (Technical\lMachine) or HM (Hidden Machine).\lThere are also people who teach moves.$

The key to making your POKéMON\nstrong is to battle and win often.\lThe EXP. (Experience) Points earned\lby winning battles accumulate to\llevel up POKéMON that participated in\lthem. Battle wild POKéMON often to\llevel up your party.$

If your foes are too strong, try\nleveling up your POKéMON some more.\lGo back the way you came and battle\lwild POKéMON to level up your party.\lYou may also battle TRAINERS whom you\lhave not battled before.$

Unlike roads and forests, wild POKéMON\ncan appear anywhere in caves.\lIf your POKéMON are hurt in a cave,\lrush to a POKéMON CENTER or use items\lto heal them right away. It is very\ldangerous to force your luck in caves.$
Trust your own knowledge and power.\nBelieve in yourself and find your way!$

A POKéMON CENTER is identified by its\nred roof and a “P.C” sign. Every\lPOKéMON CENTER offers such services as\lfully healing POKéMON and free PC use,\lmaking it essential for your travels.\lOn the upper floor are facilities for\llinking with friends and others.$
A POKéMON MART is identified by its\nblue roof and a “MART” sign.\lItems can be bought and sold at any\lPOKéMON MART. Some MARTS carry items\lthat are available only in their towns.$
You can safely end your game by\nselecting “SAVE” on the MENU.\lOnce you have saved, the game can be\lsafely turned off. When the game is\lturned back on, you can resume from\lwhere you last saved.$
POKéMON are living beings about which\nmany mysteries still remain. You may\lsee them in grass, the sea, and caves.\lThey appear to obey the wishes of the\lTRAINERS that caught them.$
Use the FAME CHECKER among the\nKEY ITEMS in your BAG.\lIt may give you a hint, so try it out.$

A HIDDEN move is taught to a POKéMON\nusing an HM (Hidden Machine).\lA HIDDEN move is important for helping\lyour adventure. For example, one is\lused to light up dark caves. Another\lcuts down small trees. There is one\lfor traveling on water, and so on.$
Try to catch wild POKéMON by throwing\nthe special SAFARI BALLS.\lYou may keep any item you find, too.$
Your SAFARI GAME ends once you have\ntraveled a certain distance or thrown\lall your SAFARI BALLS.\lOpen the MENU to check the remaining\lnumber of steps and SAFARI BALLS.$
If you would like to cut your SAFARI\nGAME short, open the MENU and select\l“RETIRE” at the top of the list.$

POKéMON GYMS are operated by the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE and are training\lfacilities for TRAINERS. They are all\lacross the land in cities and towns.\lEach one is headed by a LEADER, who\lis a very skilled TRAINER. Beat the\lLEADER to collect a BADGE.$

HP indicates a POKéMON's vitality.\nIf a POKéMON's HP drops to zero, it\lfaints and is unable to battle.\lSo, the key in battle is to try to\lreduce the foe's HP to zero.\lIf your POKéMON are hurt, restore their\lHP at a POKéMON CENTER or use items.$

EXP. Points stands for “Experience\nPoints.” POKéMON gain EXP. Points by\lparticipating in winning battles.\lWhen a POKéMON accumulates sufficient\lEXP. Points, it levels up. The EXP. Bar\lindicates accumulated EXP. Points.\lIt returns to zero upon leveling up.$

POKéMON may learn up to four different\nmoves. There are many kinds of moves\lincluding attacks and those with\lspecial effects. The kinds of moves\lthat can be learned vary for each\lPOKéMON. Some moves can be learned\lfrom items.$

ATTACK indicates the power of an\noffensive move. The higher this stat,\lthe more powerful the move.\lIt is applied for the following move\ltypes: NORMAL, POISON, GROUND,\lFLYING, BUG, FIGHTING, ROCK, GHOST,\land STEEL.$
DEFENSE indicates the resistance a\nPOKéMON has against physical attacks.\lThe higher this stat, the less damage\lsustained from a foe's physical hit.$

SP. ATK (Special Attack) indicates the\npower of a special attack move.\lThe higher this stat, the more powerful\lthe special attack move.\lIt is applied for the following move\ltypes: FIRE, WATER, ELECTRIC, GRASS,\lICE, PSYCHIC, DRAGON, and DARK.$
SP. DEF (Special Defense) indicates\nthe resistance a POKéMON has against\lspecial attacks.\lThe higher this stat, the less damage\lsustained from a foe's special attack.$
SPEED indicates the agility of a\nPOKéMON. If this stat exceeds the foe's\lin battle, the POKéMON can make a move\lbefore its slower opponent.$

Lv. (Level) indicates the growth and\nstrength of a POKéMON.\lIn general, when a POKéMON levels up,\lits stats such as HP, ATTACK, and\lDEFENSE rise, making it stronger.\lPOKéMON may learn a new move upon\lleveling up.$

POKéMON and moves are classified by\ntype. Every type has advantageous and\ldisadvantageous matchups against\lother types. For example, like a rock-\lpaper-scissors game, the WATER type is\lstrong against the FIRE type and weak\lagainst the GRASS type.$
OT stands for “Original TRAINER,”\nthe first TRAINER to have caught the\lselected POKéMON.\lEven if the POKéMON is traded, the OT\lname will remain unchanged.$

All POKéMON can be made to hold one\nitem each. Some items will be used by\lthe POKéMON automatically in certain\lsituations. To make a POKéMON hold an\litem, select the item from the BAG and\l“GIVE” it to the POKéMON.$

All POKéMON have a special ABILITY.\nThere are many different kinds of these\labilities, some used in battle, some\lelsewhere. The abilities differ from\lspecies to species. Some species may\lhave more than one kind of ability.$
Whenever you win a battle against a\nTRAINER, you are given prize money.\lSave up your prize money so you can\lenjoy shopping at POKéMON MARTS!$

Moves are also classified by types.\nIf a POKéMON of a certain type uses\la move of the same type, the move's\lpower is boosted. If the move's type\lhas a matchup advantage against the\ltarget, its effectiveness is also\lboosted.$
All POKéMON have a personality,\nor “NATURE.” The POKéMON's\lnature appears to affect how the\lPOKéMON will grow upon leveling up.$

The ID No. is a special number assigned\nspecifically to you as a TRAINER.\lTogether with the OT name, the ID No.\lis used to precisely identify the\lOriginal TRAINER.\lThe ID No. does not change even if the\lPOKéMON is traded.$
PP stands for “Power Points.”\nIt indicates the number of times a\lcertain move can be used in battle.\lLike HP, PP can be restored by visiting\la POKéMON CENTER or using certain\litems.$
POWER indicates the strength of an\nattack. The higher this number, the\lgreater the damage that can be\linflicted on the foe!$
ACCURACY indicates the probability of\nthe move hitting the foe.\lThe higher this number, the more likely\lthe move will strike the target.$
FNT stands for “fainted.”\nA POKéMON faints if its HP is reduced\lto zero. It becomes incapable of taking\lpart in battle.\lRestore a fainted POKéMON at a POKéMON\lCENTER, or use an item.$
Ordinary items bought at any POKéMON\nMART are placed in the ITEMS POCKET.\lItems may be used, given to a POKéMON\lto hold, or tossed out as garbage.$

Important items that you find or \nreceive from people are placed in the\lKEY ITEMS POCKET.\lKey items may be used, or registered\lfor use instantly with SELECT. Once\lregistered, the item can be used\lwithout opening the MENU and BAG.$

POKé BALLS, which are used for\ncatching wild POKéMON, are placed in\lthe POKé BALLS POCKET.\lPOKé BALLS may be bought at POKéMON\lMARTS. They may be used, given to a\lPOKéMON to hold, or tossed out as\lgarbage.$
This indicates the number of species of\nPOKéMON you have caught and/or\levolved to fill the POKéDEX.\lTry hard to catch all sorts of\lPOKéMON!$
This is the total amount of time that\nyou have played this game.$
The POKéMON LEAGUE BADGES that you\nhave won are registered and shown.\lEarn BADGES by defeating GYM LEADERS\lin various cities and towns.$
You can adjust how quickly the text is\ndisplayed. Choose one: SLOW, MID,\lor FAST.$
You can choose to turn the battle\nanimation ON or OFF.$
You can choose whether or not a\nTRAINER can switch a POKéMON after\lit has made its foe faint.\lSet to “SHIFT” if you would like the\lchance to switch a POKéMON after it\lhas made its foe faint.$
You can choose between MONO and\nSTEREO sound output.$

Set to “HELP” to display help messages\nby pressing the L or R Button.\lSet to “LR” to enable the switching\lof the POKéDEX pages and BAG POCKETS\lusing the L and R Buttons.\lSet to “L=A” to make the L Button\lwork the same as the A Button.$
You may choose the design of the frame\naround certain menus. Try them out and\lsee what you like.$
The settings will be changed to the\nselections shown in red, and you will\lreturn to the MENU.$

A TM (Technical Machine) is a device\nused to teach a move to a POKéMON.\lThere are many different kinds.\lMoves can be taught only to those\lPOKéMON capable of using them.\lA TM breaks after a single use.$

An HM (Hidden Machine) is a device used\nto teach a HIDDEN move to a POKéMON.\lA HIDDEN move can be taught only to\lthose POKéMON capable of using it.\lUnlike a TM, an HM can be used over\land over. A HIDDEN move can be tough\lfor a POKéMON to forget.$

HIDDEN moves are those that are\nespecially important for your\ladventure. To use such a move outside\lof battle, open the “POKéMON” MENU\land make the POKéMON that knows the\lmove use it. A fainted POKéMON may use\la HIDDEN move outside of battle.$

Among POKéMON, there are some that\nundergo major changes (evolution) upon\lgrowing to certain levels. Evolution\lcauses a POKéMON to alter form, change\lits name, and perhaps change the moves\lit may learn. Some POKéMON evolve\ldue to reasons other than leveling up.$

Status problems include:\nSleep: Can't use moves.\lPoison: Causes steady HP loss.\lParalysis: May prevent moves.\lBurn: HP loss and lowers ATTACK.\lFreeze: Can't use moves.\lThese can be healed with items, etc.$
POKéMON is a name given to describe\nwondrous creatures that inhabit all\lcorners of this world.\lPeople raise POKéMON to be their pets,\luse them for battling, and so on.$

The ID No. is a special number assigned\nspecifically to you as a TRAINER.\lTogether with the OT name, the ID No.\lis used to precisely identify the\lOriginal TRAINER.\lThe ID No. does not change even if the\lPOKéMON is traded.$
Whenever you win a battle against a\nTRAINER, you are given prize money.\lSave up your prize money so you can\lenjoy shopping at POKéMON MARTS!$
This indicates the number of POKéMON\nLEAGUE BADGES that you have won.\lEarn BADGES by defeating GYM LEADERS\lin various cities and towns.$
Visit every city and town, travel every\nroad, explore every cave, and face\levery challenge as you strive to\lbecome the greatest TRAINER of\lPOKéMON!$

On your adventure, you will be faced\nwith many obstacles. Every obstacle\lcan be overcome by doing something\lor by solving mysteries. Some obstacles\lare affected by something that happens\lfar away.$
Some of the obstacles in your way can\nbe removed once your POKéMON learn\lspecific moves.$

POKéMON are wondrous creatures that\nare shrouded in mystery. You may meet\lthem all over the world…in tall\lgrass, caves, the sea, and more.\lThey appear to grow obedient to the\lTRAINERS that caught them.$
